posts.title: Bill ya chapo kibanda

lines.text: Chapo nne na madondo mbili zimeenda safi sana.
Sawa, lakini waiter anakuja na bill yetu sasa hivi.
Niuzie tu fifty bob kwa M-Pesa nirudishe jioni Sasha.
Screenshot ya deni yako ya jana bado iko pinned kwa group.

posts.caption:
Wale marafiki wa kusema 'tuma nitakurudishia jioni' kabla bill ifike.

Nani hulipia bill kila siku kwa squad yenu?

Animated skit: characters are fictional. #MtaaMode #Nairobi

critic.note: Drop formal words like 'waiter' for a kibanda setting and make Sasha threaten to post the current bill to that same group.

warnings: caption has no send/share/save call: sends and saves drive reach

posts.title: Token zikiisha kwa ploti

lines.text: Stima imezimika kwa ploti mzima na token iliisha jana.
Nilikuwa naenda kununua, niko njiani kutoka stage sai.
Kevo, unanipita hapa kwa staircase na powerbank yangu!
Kumbe unatembea kwa giza ukiambia watu uko stage?
By the way Landlord, nauza solar bulb mia tatu tu.

posts.caption:
Kevo anasema ako njiani na kumbe amejificha tu kwa stairs.

Kuna jirani kama Kevo kwa ploti yenu?

Animated skit: characters are fictional. #MtaaMode #Nairobi

critic.note: Dee pitching a solar bulb derails the tension; having Landlord confiscate Kevo's powerbank as token collateral would hit harder.

posts.title: WhatsApp forwards za Mathe

lines.text: Mathe, nimeona ile video ya dakika thelathini umenitumia WhatsApp.
Umeona vile vijana wenzako wananunulia wazazi wao gari?
Nilikuwa naomba fare ya kwenda interview ya job tao.
Nimetuma prayer ya safari kwa WhatsApp, ifungue utembee nayo.

posts.caption:
Mathe akikujibu na WhatsApp forward badala ya kutuma fare.

Mathe wako pia hutuma maombi badala ya mchango?

Animated skit: characters are fictional. #MtaaMode #Nairobi

critic.note: Change 'dakika thelathini' to 'video ya thirty minutes' so Brayo sounds like a real Nairobian youth.
